name: Four Arms
abilities: Shock waves via punches, stomps and the four-handed 'Big Smack' clap
Wall scaling by driving fingers into surfaces
weaknesses: Bulk makes him an easy target and a poor fit for small spaces
A cold severely reduces his strength and stamina
summary: Ben's 12-foot red Tetramand strongman: four arms, armour-plated skin and enough raw muscle to swing a mammoth or shatter a Rock Monster in one punch.
traits: Learned the sonic clap from Tini of the Galactic Enforcers
Stronger than Humungousaur at base size
OV 16-year-old has a moustache-like ridge and head spikes
notableFeats: Spun Dr. Animo's reanimated mammoth apart (Washington B.C.)
Defeated Kevin after Kevin absorbed his DNA (Kevin 11)
Won the wrestling tournament against the Immovable Object and others (Ready to Rumble)
Beat Captain Nemesis in a tug of war (Hero Time)
Overpowered Princess Looma, a female Tetramand (Many Happy Returns)
Threw Rex hard enough to shatter his Smack Hands (Heroes United)

appearances.designNotes: White T-shirt with a black centre stripe, black pants with foot straps, black fingerless gloves, orange-yellow eyes, no hair, original Omnitrix on the upper-left shoulder. Ben 10,000's version is bulkier with jutting incisors and the Omnitrix on his chest.

16-year-old: shirtless with gold wrist/ankle bands, black briefs with gold waistband, two gold chest sashes, black ponytail, green eyes, Ultimatrix on chest. 10-year-old (Forge of Creation) is the OS design with a green Omnitrix.

16-year-old: three short head spikes, moustache-like ridge, second set of pectorals, black tank top with a green centre stripe, black pants, green/white Omnitrix belt, black gloves with green cuffs. 11-year-old: OS outfit with green eyes, lighter skin and a second set of pectorals.

scoring.rationale: The strength anchor of the OS roster: swings mammoths, launches opponents over the horizon and shrugs off falls from hundreds of feet. Slow, purely melee and a big target; electricity hurts him badly.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked; unlocked off-screen before UA's Video Games).
Also used by Kevin (Framed), Gwen (Gwen 10, non-canon) - not counted. Skurd borrowed his arms in The Final Countdown.
Fusions: Stink Arms (OS) and Fourmungousaur (OV, via Biomnitrix).
Editorial score calibration (principal pass): special 3→4, versatility 4→5, durability 7→8 — to keep the roster ladder consistent across research batches.
